Agent Name: GameTheory_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: They mis-modeled the distribution constraint by forcing c = b + 6 under a ≤ b ≤ c, which only captures cases where the largest and middle boxes differ by 6 and excludes valid cases where the 6-gap could be between the smallest and middle. They then listed incorrect triples (several sums don’t equal 30 and don’t match their own calculations), and from this flawed set concluded Bob could guarantee all 30 coins by guessing 2, 11, 17. This incorrect modeling and enumeration led to the wrong “optimal strategy” and incorrect minimum winnings.
